commands.title: Flatten a folder tree (copy)
commands.description: Copies every file from all subfolders into one folder. Duplicate names become name_1.ext, name_2.ext instead of overwriting.
commands.note: The destination must be outside the source folder, otherwise the copies get picked up again.

commands.title: Flatten a folder tree (move)
commands.description: Same as the copy version but moves files, leaving the empty subfolders behind.
commands.note: Run the empty-folder cleanup afterwards to remove what is left.

commands.title: Delete all empty folders
commands.description: Removes empty directories, deepest first, so parents emptied by the pass are removed too.
commands.note: Remove -WhatIf to actually delete. The preview only lists the folders that are empty right now, not the parents that would become empty.

commands.title: Find duplicate files
commands.description: Groups files by size first, then hashes only the candidates, and prints each set of identical files.
commands.command: Get-ChildItem -Recurse -File | Group-Object Length | Where-Object Count -gt 1 | ForEach-Object Group | Get-FileHash | Group-Object Hash | Where-Object Count -gt 1 | ForEach-Object { $_.Group.Path; "" }

commands.title: Find the largest files
commands.description: Top 50 biggest files under a path with sizes in GB.
commands.command: Get-ChildItem C:\ -Recurse -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Sort-Object Length -Descending | Select-Object -First 50 FullName, @{N="GB"; E={[math]::Round($_.Length/1GB, 2)}}

commands.title: Size of every subfolder
commands.description: Totals each immediate subfolder in MB, biggest first.

commands.title: Disk usage by file type
commands.description: Counts files and totals size per extension.
commands.command: Get-ChildItem -Recurse -File | Group-Object Extension | Select-Object Name, Count, @{N="MB"; E={[math]::Round(($_.Group | Measure-Object Length -Sum).Sum / 1MB, 1)}} | Sort-Object MB -Descending

commands.title: Find files by name pattern
commands.description: Searches the whole tree for a filename pattern.
commands.command: Get-ChildItem C:\Users\YourName -Recurse -Filter "*invoice*.pdf" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object FullName, Length, LastWriteTime

commands.title: Find files not touched in 3 years
commands.description: Lists files whose last write time is older than three years, oldest first.
commands.command: Get-ChildItem C:\Users\YourName -Recurse -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object LastWriteTime -lt (Get-Date).AddYears(-3) | Sort-Object LastWriteTime | Select-Object FullName, LastWriteTime

commands.title: Delete files older than 30 days
commands.description: Removes files whose last write time is older than 30 days.
commands.note: Remove -WhatIf to actually delete.

commands.title: Files changed recently
commands.description: Files modified in the last 7 days, newest first.
commands.command: Get-ChildItem -Recurse -File | Where-Object LastWriteTime -gt (Get-Date).AddDays(-7) | Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending | Select-Object FullName, LastWriteTime

commands.title: Files created today
commands.description: Lists files whose creation time is today.

commands.title: Find paths that are too long
commands.description: Finds files with a full path over 240 characters, which tend to break copies and zips.

commands.title: Clear the read-only flag everywhere
commands.description: Removes the read-only attribute from every file under the current folder.

commands.title: Delete every node_modules folder
commands.description: Finds and removes all node_modules directories below the current folder.
commands.note: Remove -WhatIf to actually delete. Slow on huge trees because it walks into each node_modules first.

commands.title: Unblock downloaded files
commands.description: Removes the downloaded-from-the-internet mark so Windows stops warning about every file.

commands.title: Compare two folders
commands.description: Shows files that exist in only one of two folders, compared by relative path.
commands.note: <= means only in A, => means only in B.

commands.title: Mirror a folder with robocopy
commands.description: Makes the destination an exact copy of the source, including deleting extra files there. /L lists what would happen without doing it.
commands.note: Remove /L to run for real. /MIR deletes files in the destination that are not in the source.

commands.title: Pick files in a GUI, then act on them
commands.description: Opens a filterable grid, and only the rows you select continue down the pipeline.
commands.command: Get-ChildItem -Recurse -File | Select-Object FullName, Length, LastWriteTime | Out-GridView -PassThru -Title "Select files" | ForEach-Object { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $_.FullName -WhatIf }
commands.note: Remove -WhatIf to actually delete the selected files. Windows PowerShell 5.1 or the Microsoft.PowerShell.GraphicalTools module.

commands.title: Export a folder inventory to CSV
commands.description: Dumps path, size, and dates for everything under a folder.
commands.command: Get-ChildItem C:\Projects -Recurse -File | Select-Object FullName, Length, CreationTime, LastWriteTime | Export-Csv inventory.csv -NoTypeInformation -Encoding UTF8

commands.title: Bulk rename with find and replace
commands.description: Replaces part of every matching filename.

commands.title: Sequential numbering
commands.description: Renames files to photo_001.jpg, photo_002.jpg and so on, in name order.

commands.title: Change file extensions
commands.description: Changes .jpeg to .jpg for every file in the folder.

commands.title: Add a prefix to every filename
commands.description: Prepends text to all files in the current folder.

commands.title: Prefix filenames with their modified date
commands.description: Turns photo.jpg into 2026-03-14-photo.jpg using the last write time.

commands.title: Lowercase every filename
commands.description: Converts names to lowercase, going through a temporary name because Windows ignores case changes.

commands.title: Replace spaces with underscores
commands.description: Cleans up filenames for scripts and web use.

commands.title: Sort files into folders by extension
commands.description: Creates a folder per extension and moves matching files into it.

commands.title: Sort files into year-month folders
commands.description: Moves each file into a folder like 2026-03 based on its modified date.

commands.title: Auto-organize Downloads
commands.description: Moves known file types from Downloads into Images, PDFs, Archives, and Docs, creating folders as needed.
commands.note: A file whose name already exists in the target folder is skipped with an error rather than overwritten.

commands.title: Search inside files
commands.description: Finds a string in file contents across a project, showing file, line number, and the line.

commands.title: Search for several terms at once
commands.description: Matches any of several words and lists the hits.

commands.title: List only the files that contain a term
commands.description: One path per matching file instead of every matching line.

commands.title: Search with surrounding lines
commands.description: Shows two lines before and after each match, like grep -C 2.

commands.title: Replace text across a project
commands.description: Replaces a string in every matching file, rewriting only the files that contain it.
commands.note: Windows PowerShell 5.1 writes UTF-8 with a BOM. Back up first or work in a git repo.

commands.title: Count lines of code
commands.description: Total line count across selected file types.

commands.title: Convert line endings to LF
commands.description: Rewrites CRLF to LF in the selected files.

commands.title: Merge every CSV in a folder
commands.description: Combines all CSVs that share the same columns into one file.
commands.command: Get-ChildItem *.csv | ForEach-Object { Import-Csv $_.FullName } | Export-Csv merged.csv -NoTypeInformation -Encoding UTF8

commands.title: Filter a CSV
commands.description: Keeps only rows that match a condition and saves the result.
commands.command: Import-Csv data.csv | Where-Object { [int]$_.Qty -gt 10 } | Export-Csv filtered.csv -NoTypeInformation -Encoding UTF8

commands.title: Remove duplicate CSV rows
commands.description: Drops rows that are identical across every column.
commands.command: Import-Csv in.csv | Sort-Object * -Unique | Export-Csv out.csv -NoTypeInformation -Encoding UTF8
commands.note: Output order changes because of the sort.

commands.title: Count rows per value
commands.description: Quick pivot: how many rows for each value of a column.
commands.command: Import-Csv data.csv | Group-Object Category | Sort-Object Count -Descending | Select-Object Name, Count

commands.title: Convert CSV to JSON
commands.description: Turns a CSV into a JSON array of objects.
commands.command: Import-Csv data.csv | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5 | Set-Content data.json -Encoding UTF8

commands.title: Convert JSON to CSV
commands.description: Flattens a JSON array of flat objects into a CSV.
commands.command: Get-Content data.json -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json | Export-Csv data.csv -NoTypeInformation -Encoding UTF8

commands.title: Pretty-print JSON
commands.description: Reformats a minified JSON file with indentation.

commands.title: Merge text files
commands.description: Concatenates many text files into one.
commands.command: Get-ChildItem *.txt | Sort-Object Name | Get-Content | Set-Content merged.txt -Encoding UTF8

commands.title: Sort and deduplicate lines
commands.description: Writes each unique line once, in sorted order.
commands.command: Get-Content in.txt | Sort-Object -Unique | Set-Content out.txt -Encoding UTF8

commands.title: Interactive sortable table
commands.description: Shows any command's output in a window you can sort and filter by clicking.

commands.title: Export command output to an HTML table
commands.description: Generates a standalone HTML report from any output.
commands.command: Get-Process | Select-Object Name, Id, @{N="MB"; E={[math]::Round($_.WorkingSet64/1MB, 1)}} | ConvertTo-Html -Title "Processes" | Out-File processes.html -Encoding UTF8

commands.title: Generate a large test CSV
commands.description: Creates 100,000 rows of fake data for testing import and search code.
commands.command: 1..100000 | ForEach-Object { [pscustomobject]@{ ID = $_; Name = "User$_"; Value = Get-Random -Minimum 1 -Maximum 10000 } } | Export-Csv test-data.csv -NoTypeInformation -Encoding UTF8

commands.title: Image to base64 data URI
commands.description: Encodes an image and copies a ready-to-paste data URI to the clipboard for embedding in single-file HTML.

commands.title: Kill whatever is using a port
commands.description: Finds the process listening on a port and stops it.
commands.note: Change 3000 to your port. Add -WhatIf to preview.

commands.title: Kill processes by name
commands.description: Stops every process whose name matches a pattern.
commands.note: Add -WhatIf to Stop-Process to preview.

commands.title: Biggest memory consumers
commands.description: Top 20 processes by RAM, with multiple instances of the same app summed.
commands.command: Get-Process | Group-Object ProcessName | Select-Object Name, @{N="RAM_GB"; E={[math]::Round(($_.Group | Measure-Object WorkingSet64 -Sum).Sum/1GB, 2)}} | Sort-Object RAM_GB -Descending | Select-Object -First 20

commands.title: Biggest CPU consumers
commands.description: Top 10 processes by accumulated CPU time.
commands.command: Get-Process | Sort-Object CPU -Descending | Select-Object -First 10 Name, Id, @{N="CPU_s"; E={[math]::Round($_.CPU, 1)}}

commands.title: List stopped services
commands.description: Shows every service that is not running.
commands.command: Get-Service | Where-Object Status -eq Stopped | Sort-Object DisplayName

commands.title: Restart a service
commands.description: Restarts a Windows service, for example the print spooler.

commands.title: List startup programs
commands.description: Shows everything configured to launch at login.
commands.command: Get-CimInstance Win32_StartupCommand | Select-Object Name, Command, Location, User

commands.title: Restart Windows Explorer
commands.description: Fixes a frozen taskbar or desktop without rebooting. Explorer relaunches itself.

commands.title: Free space on every drive
commands.description: Used and free GB per drive.
commands.command: Get-PSDrive -PSProvider FileSystem | Select-Object Name, @{N="UsedGB"; E={[math]::Round($_.Used/1GB, 1)}}, @{N="FreeGB"; E={[math]::Round($_.Free/1GB, 1)}}

commands.title: List installed software
commands.description: Reads both the 64-bit and 32-bit uninstall keys and sorts the result.
commands.command: Get-ItemProperty HKLM:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\*, HKLM:\Software\WOW6432Node\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\* | Where-Object DisplayName | Select-Object DisplayName, DisplayVersion, Publisher | Sort-Object DisplayName

commands.title: Basic system info
commands.description: OS, version, and installed RAM.

commands.title: How long since last boot
commands.description: Time elapsed since the machine started.

commands.title: Recent system errors
commands.description: The last 50 error-level events from the System log in the past day.
commands.command: Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{ LogName = 'System'; Level = 2; StartTime = (Get-Date).AddDays(-1) } -MaxEvents 50 | Select-Object TimeCreated, ProviderName, Message

commands.title: List active scheduled tasks
commands.description: Shows tasks that are not disabled.
commands.command: Get-ScheduledTask | Where-Object State -ne 'Disabled' | Select-Object TaskName, TaskPath, State

commands.title: Clean temporary files
commands.description: Deletes everything in your temp folder that is not locked by a running program.
commands.note: Remove -WhatIf to actually delete.

commands.title: Empty the recycle bin
commands.description: Clears it for every drive without a prompt.

commands.title: Show PATH one entry per line
commands.description: Makes the PATH variable readable.

commands.title: Add a folder to your user PATH
commands.description: Permanently appends a folder to the user PATH. Open a new terminal afterwards.

commands.title: Laptop battery health report
commands.description: Generates an HTML report with capacity history and cycle count.

commands.title: Update every installed app
commands.description: Upgrades everything winget knows about.

commands.title: Repair Windows system files
commands.description: Checks and repairs the component store, then protected system files.

commands.title: Show a saved Wi-Fi password
commands.description: Prints the stored key for a network you have connected to before.
commands.command: netsh wlan show profile name="NetworkName" key=clear
commands.note: Look for Key Content in the output. Use netsh wlan show profiles to list networks.

commands.title: Copy a file list to the clipboard
commands.description: Puts all filenames in the current folder on the clipboard, one per line.

commands.title: Copy a file's contents to the clipboard
commands.description: Puts the whole text of a file on the clipboard.

commands.title: Listening ports with process names
commands.description: Shows what is listening on which port.
commands.command: Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen | Select-Object LocalAddress, LocalPort, @{N="Process"; E={(Get-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).ProcessName}} | Sort-Object LocalPort

commands.title: Test whether a port is reachable
commands.description: Checks a TCP connection to a host and port.

commands.title: Flush the DNS cache
commands.description: Clears cached DNS lookups.

commands.title: Show your public IP
commands.description: Asks an external service for the address the internet sees.

commands.title: Download files from a list of URLs
commands.description: Downloads every URL in a text file into the current folder.

commands.title: Call a JSON API
commands.description: Fetches JSON and parses it into objects you can pipe.

commands.title: Zip a folder
commands.description: Compresses a folder into a zip file.

commands.title: Unzip an archive
commands.description: Extracts a zip into a folder.

commands.title: Zip every subfolder separately
commands.description: Creates one zip per subfolder next to it.

commands.title: Checksum a file
commands.description: Computes a SHA256 hash to verify a download or detect changes.

commands.title: Watch a folder for new files
commands.description: Prints a message whenever a file appears in a folder or its subfolders, for as long as the session stays open.
commands.command:
$w = New-Object IO.FileSystemWatcher "C:\Watched"
$w.IncludeSubdirectories = $true
$w.EnableRaisingEvents = $true
Register-ObjectEvent $w Created -SourceIdentifier NewFile -Action { Write-Host "New file: $($Event.SourceEventArgs.FullPath)" }
commands.note: Stop it with Unregister-Event NewFile.

commands.title: Time how long something takes
commands.description: Wraps any script block and reports the duration.
commands.command: Measure-Command { Get-ChildItem C:\Windows -Recurse -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Out-Null } | Select-Object TotalSeconds

commands.title: Delete merged git branches
commands.description: Removes local branches already merged into the current one, except main, master, and the current branch.
commands.command: git branch --merged | Where-Object { $_ -notmatch '^\*|main|master' } | ForEach-Object { git branch -d $_.Trim() }

commands.title: Run npm install in every project folder
commands.description: Finds subfolders that contain a package.json and installs dependencies in each.
commands.command: Get-ChildItem -Directory | Where-Object { Test-Path (Join-Path $_.FullName "package.json") } | ForEach-Object { Push-Location $_.FullName; npm install; Pop-Location }

commands.title: Concatenate source files into one
commands.description: Joins JS files in name order into a single bundle file.
commands.command: Get-ChildItem src\*.js | Sort-Object Name | Get-Content | Set-Content bundle.js -Encoding UTF8

commands.title: Scaffold a project in one go
commands.description: Creates a folder structure, copies a template into it, installs dependencies, and opens the folder.
commands.command:
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path C:\Project\src, C:\Project\tests, C:\Project\docs -Force | Out-Null
Copy-Item C:\Templates\* C:\Project -Recurse
Set-Location C:\Project
npm install
explorer .

commands.title: Create folders from a list
commands.description: Makes one folder per line in a text file.
commands.command: Get-Content names.txt | Where-Object { $_.Trim() } | ForEach-Object { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Name $_.Trim() -Force }

commands.title: Generate many test files
commands.description: Creates 10,000 small files quickly using .NET instead of New-Item.

commands.title: Generate a GUID
commands.description: Creates a new random UUID and copies it to the clipboard.

commands.title: Create your own command
commands.description: Defines a reusable function. Put it in your profile to keep it permanently.
commands.command: function Find-BigFiles { param($Path = "C:\", $Count = 20) Get-ChildItem $Path -Recurse -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Sort-Object Length -Descending | Select-Object -First $Count FullName, @{N="GB"; E={[math]::Round($_.Length/1GB, 2)}} }
commands.note: Run notepad $PROFILE to open the file that loads at every startup.

commands.title: Run a script every day
commands.description: Registers a scheduled task that runs a .ps1 file daily at 9am.
commands.note: Remove it with Unregister-ScheduledTask -TaskName DailyCleanup -Confirm:$false.

commands.title: Install Everything and its command-line tool
commands.description: Everything indexes the NTFS Master File Table, so searches return instantly. es.exe lets PowerShell query that index.
commands.command:
winget install voidtools.Everything
winget install voidtools.Everything.Cli
commands.note: Everything must be running (or its service installed) for es.exe to return results. Run es.exe -h to confirm the flags on your version.

commands.title: Find files by name instantly
commands.description: Name search across every NTFS drive using Everything's index.

commands.title: Largest files on the machine
commands.description: Top 50 files by size across all indexed drives in a fraction of a second.

commands.title: Files modified today
commands.description: Everything modified today, newest first, across all drives.

commands.title: Search one folder by extension
commands.description: Restricts the search to a folder tree and several extensions.

commands.title: List empty folders
commands.description: Finds empty directories across the drive using Everything's empty: function.

commands.title: Find files that share a name
commands.description: Lists files whose names appear more than once, a quick first pass before hashing.

commands.title: Turn Everything results into file objects
commands.description: Pipes matching paths into Get-Item so you can use normal PowerShell properties and cmdlets.
commands.command: es.exe -n 100 ext:log 'dm:>2026-09-01' | ForEach-Object { Get-Item -LiteralPath $_ } | Select-Object FullName, Length, LastWriteTime

commands.title: Export Everything results to a PowerShell table
commands.description: Uses es.exe's CSV output with size and modified date columns and parses it into objects.

commands.title: Delete everything that matches a search
commands.description: Deletes old temp files found by Everything. Search first, review, then remove -WhatIf.
commands.note: Remove -WhatIf to actually delete. Always run the es.exe search alone first and read the list.

commands.title: Show NTFS Master File Table details
commands.description: Reports MFT size and layout for a volume. PowerShell has no built-in way to read the MFT itself, which is why tools like Everything exist.

commands.title: Fastest built-in recursive file listing
commands.description: Streams files through .NET directly, skipping the per-object overhead of Get-ChildItem, and ignores folders it cannot open.
commands.note: Returns plain path strings, not file objects. Wrap with Get-Item if you need properties.

commands.title: Fast listing with cmd dir
commands.description: Plain-text recursive file listing that is usually much faster than Get-ChildItem on large trees.
